modifications: Reproducing and diagnosing call systematic-debugging whole, now diagnosis-only (H9, B3).

Delegation follows the local rule instead of being mandatory (report 4.3).
Running the command replaces the control skills for our CLI and Python surfaces.

Committing the red test first, which needs commit authority (B8).
Opening a PR (batch 1's land skill supplies the closeout; the PR flow stays deferred).
